review_locator: PMCID:PMC7015949, Immunoregulatory Sensory Circuits in Group 3 Innate Lymphoid Cell Function and Tissue Homeostasis; PMCID:PMC6515929, Innate Lymphoid Cells in Mucosal Immunity
primary_title: Innate lymphoid cells regulate intestinal epithelial cell glycosylation
decision_basis: The reviews identify the Goto primary showing that commensal-stimulated ILC3-derived IL-22 induces epithelial Fut2 expression and fucosylation in the mouse intestine.
limitations_preserved: Expression/gene-level and epithelial-fucosylation output only; preserve commensal/Salmonella and mouse ileal context, ILC3-derived IL-22 source, and the contribution of ILC3-derived lymphotoxin; do not infer Fut2 protein secretion, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effects.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7015949, Immunoregulatory Sensory Circuits in Group 3 Innate Lymphoid Cell Function and Tissue Homeostasis; PMCID:PMC7120444, Interleukin-22: A Bridge Between Epithelial Innate Host Defense and Immune Cells
primary_title: Innate lymphoid cell type 3-derived interleukin-22 boosts lipocalin-2 production in intestinal epithelial cells via synergy between STAT3 and NF-kappaB
decision_basis: The reviews identify the Coorens primary showing that ILC3-derived IL-22 regulates epithelial lipocalin-2 and that IL-22 neutralization reduces LCN2 protein release from human intestinal epithelial cells.
limitations_preserved: Measured protein-output bridge; preserve human tonsil ILC3 supernatant, co-cytokine exposure, HT-29 epithelial context and IL-22-neutralization boundary; do not infer LCN2 transcript as an unmeasured intermediate, universal ILC3 sufficiency, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effects.
